question: Does the newly installed Google adapter expose and read each of the three format children of one existing native Doc and one existing native Sheet through the live FUSE mount?
kind: Pre-registered read-only live mount probe; no Google mutation.
source_items: One existing Doc in the connected Workspace My Drive and one existing Sheet in the connected personal My Drive, selected by exact item identity before the run; item names and IDs remain in a private manifest.
arms: A: confirm the developer-installed daemon is running the merged binary and each selected parent is a native package in the expected account and collection
B: enumerate each package and require its three expected format children and browser link without changing any remote item
C: read each child through FUSE in bounded local staging, require the expected PDF or ZIP/OOXML/OpenDocument signature and an exact repeated hash from the same mount
endpoint: Six format children can be listed and read with exact repeated hashes. Any single failure is recorded without claiming all Google documents work.
prediction: The selected small native Doc and Sheet should yield all six readable formats because the direct Drive export probe succeeded on two run-owned Shared Drive fixtures and synthetic package routing passed. Existing items may differ, so export size or API permissions can still fail.
limits: One Doc and one Sheet are only a bounded smoke test. No text or spreadsheet content, name, ID, token or raw provider response is published. This does not establish conversion fidelity or large-export support.
temporary_filesystem: btrfs under /home; TMPDIR and SQLITE_TMPDIR were private and not tmpfs
installed_binary: Developer install from source commit 29aec1b, whose tree matched merged main 1ce402e; installed cirroved SHA-256 matched the release binary. The daemon was active, and the three pre-existing mounts were ready with zero failed uploads and zero stuck changes before the probe.

result.first_attempt: Failed after 5.4 seconds at an assertion; the initial diagnostic emitted only the exception class, so the exact failed assertion cannot be reconstructed. No conclusion is drawn from this attempt.
result.correction: The private probe was changed to report a bounded phase on failure without exposing names, IDs or content. No source or mounted data was changed.
result.retries: Two immediate subsequent attempts passed, each finding the six expected format children and browser links. All six read twice with identical SHA-256 per attempt and valid PDF, OOXML or OpenDocument signatures.
result.interpretation: The installed mount can present and read these six exports for the selected two existing items. The first-attempt failure remains unexplained; this record cannot establish reliable cold opening after an install or for other Google items.
